summary: Created `opsadmin` on node1 with a node-generated password, private `/home/opsadmin`, and full administrative privileges. Restart persistence and recovery were verified.
actions_performed: Added `opsadmin` to `wheel`; effective sudo policy grants `(ALL) ALL`.
Safely restarted node1 and verified a changed boot identity, healthy system state, active SSH, and persistent account configuration.

evidence.summary: Direct pre- and post-restart evidence shows the local passwd entry, UID/GID, Bash shell, wheel membership, and a set password.
Shows `/home/opsadmin` owned by `opsadmin:opsadmin` with mode 0700; post-restart checks prove owner access and denial to `nobody`.
Effective sudo policy before and after restart explicitly grants `opsadmin` `(ALL) ALL`.

Baseline boot ID was `5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc`; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to `f1c771c4-bccc-435c-ba8c-10df3df2886f`, with system running, SSH active, and all account state recovered.
